senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בד; cmp. בז, to enter into, split, separate; v. בדל, בדק, בדר &c.)to scatter.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:2">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top <he>בּוֹדְדָהּ ברגלו</he> he scatters it (the frank-incense) with his foot (shoves it apart).

senses.gloss: to dig out, create, choose, invent. Denom. בַּד II, בַּדִּים.

units: Pesik. R. s. 29 (30), expl. בדד (Lam. I, 1) = בּוֹדֵד lonely, forsaken. Part. pass. בָּדוּד exiled.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>בגדים בדודים</he> Ar. (read <he>בגדי</he>) garments of the exiled (<he>כלי גולה</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 46:19">Jer. XLVI, 19</cite>); [ed. <he>בגדי בָדָד</he>, a. <cite ref="B00111"><he>בְּדָדִין</he></cite>, v. next w.].

senses.gloss: to be exiled, homeless. Lam. R. introd. (R. Alexandri 1) (ref. to Ps. CII, 8) as the bird מִתְבּוֹדֵד וכ׳ is driven (separated from the rest) from roof to roof.
